title: ‘Where’s the UK?’: Trump’s Gaza snub exposes limits of British influence
summary: Trump sidelines Starmer day after US ambassador to Israel called Bridget Phillipson ‘delusional’ for saying UK played key role For British officials who had spent the last 24 hours talking up the UK’s role in negotiating peace in Gaza, Monday’s press conference by Donald Trump in Egypt was a brutal lesson in realpolitik. “Where’s the United Kingdom?” asked the US president before ushering up Keir Starmer, who had been stood behind him. Without allowing the prime minister to say a word, Trump briefly shook the prime minister’s hand before turning his back on him and continuing to explain how he had brought peace to the Middle East.
